create-event.why: Creates event with agent-written text and can invite external attendees

create-events.why: Bulk creates events with agent text and optional invitations

delete-event.why: Deletes event; cancellation notices carry no agent text

get-current-time.why: Returns current date and time only

get-event.why: Returns one event including attendees and description others wrote

get-freebusy.why: Returns busy and free blocks; availability is private

list-calendars.why: Lists the user's calendar names and ids

list-colors.why: Lists colour ids and event labels only

list-events.why: Lists events; invites and descriptions come from other people

manage-accounts.why: Lists, adds or removes OAuth account connections; no calendar content

respond-to-event.why: Accepts or declines an invite; optional comment may reach organiser

search-events.why: Searches event text including descriptions written by others

update-event.why: Edits event text and attendees; can send updates to guests
